heading: Restrictions on public use of United States Capitol Grounds
lead: Public travel in, and occupancy of, the United States Capitol Grounds is restricted to the roads, walks, and places prepared for that purpose.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 510340:193b.July 31, 1946, ch. 707, § 2, 60 Stat. 718. The words “by flagging, paving, or otherwise” are omitted as unnecessary.
